spanish: Y harás sobre el pectoral cadenas de obra trenzada, obra de cordón, oro puro.
grammarChanges: joshen -> el pectoral: הַחֹשֶׁן is a definite common noun and must stay in Spanish, not transliterated.
de borde -> de obra trenzada: גַּבְלֻת names 'twisted/wreathen work', not a boundary/edge sense.
cadenillas -> cadenas: שַׁרְשֹׁת is plain feminine plural construct; the diminutive -illas is not licensed by the morphology.
